Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
1. How are trades made from hand? I think there is a rule about not being
allowed to show cards to other players. Do one have to discuss the trading
open for all players to hear, or can one leave the room? (in tournament of
course)

2. Is it allowed to trade vampires.

3. What happens if I get control of a tapped card (i.e. Barrens) in my
untap? Can I untap it and use it right away?

4. Is it allowed to trade the club itself? If so, two or more players could
use cards that act in the masterphase, like Palatial estate...

5. What does the last sentence mean? Really? Example!

Succubus Club [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Master
Master: unique location. Methuselahs can give you pool, and you can give
them pool. You can trade cards from your hand or in play. These trades can
only happen during your untap phase and cannot result in any Methuselah
having less than his or her hand size. Any additional terms can be
established, but none are enfoced by the rules.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henke wrote:
>
> 1. How are trades made from hand? I think there is a rule about not being
> allowed to show cards to other players. Do one have to discuss the trading
> open for all players to hear, or can one leave the room? (in tournament of
> course)

Open discussion.

> 2. Is it allowed to trade vampires.

Controlled vampires, yes.
Vampires from the ash heap, uncontrolled region, or crypt? no.

> 3. What happens if I get control of a tapped card (i.e. Barrens) in my
> untap? Can I untap it and use it right away?

No. There's nothing to indicate that you get to untap it. And untapping
all your cards was the first thing that happens in your untap phase, before
you get to trade in new stuff via Succeubus Club. [4]

> 4. Is it allowed to trade the club itself? If so, two or more players could
> use cards that act in the masterphase, like Palatial estate...

Yes.

> 5. What does the last sentence mean? Really? Example!

As in your example of trading the Club itself back and forth - you've established
additional terms ("and you'll trade it back to me on your turn") which are
not enforced by the rules (your trading partner is free to keep it for herself
on her turn instead of trading it back to you).

Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
> Henke wrote:
>>
>> 1. How are trades made from hand? I think there is a rule about not being
>> allowed to show cards to other players. Do one have to discuss the trading
>> open for all players to hear, or can one leave the room? (in tournament of
>> course)
>
> Open discussion.

You could, of course, agree to trade all 7 cards in your hand for all 7
cards in their hand, which would be looking only at "your" cards, but cut
through all the crap, and allow you to make private trades.
Of course, they might not give the cards BACK to you if they really like
them, but that's another matter.

>> 3. What happens if I get control of a tapped card (i.e. Barrens) in my
>> untap? Can I untap it and use it right away?
>
> No. There's nothing to indicate that you get to untap it. And untapping
> all your cards was the first thing that happens in your untap phase, before
> you get to trade in new stuff via Succeubus Club. [4]

But you can use "during your untap" effects, yes? You could borrow a
Hunting ground, gain the blood, and then give it back, yes? Perhaps in
trade for first borrowing and putting a blood on their Powerbase:Chicago and
then giving it back?

--
Pat Ricochet
